name: Barbell Standing Twist
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, knees softly unlocked, and a light barbell resting securely across your upper back.
Brace your abs and keep your pelvis facing steadily forward.
Rotate your rib cage and the bar smoothly a modest distance to one side using your obliques.
Return slowly through center and twist to the opposite side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep the arc modest and controlled so you never whip your spine at the end of a turn.
Keep your hips quiet so the rotation comes cleanly from your obliques and mid-back.
